# Format Number

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Formats a number to the given decimal places.

## Syntax

~~~~text
formatNumber(number: <#Number (Allows Variables)#>, places: <#Number (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
formatNumber(number: 10023.3323, places: 2)
~~~~
